Talia Park: Hey team! Talia here — excited to join Redwood as a Sr. PM on Growth. Vancouver-based, into ultralight backpacking, bouldering, and I rescue hedgehogs (yes really) — Niblet says hi 🦔
Miguel Santos: Welcome Talia!! Hedgie pics plz :D
Jess Lee: woohoo welcome! Your desk is 3B by the plant wall. Slack me for a chair swap if you need one.
Karen O'Neill: Hi Talia — onboarding buddy is @Ravi Shah, he'll ping you about the kickoff call. Also any dietary restrictions for welcome lunch?
Talia Park: Thanks all! No dietary restrictions. Pronouns she/her. I'll bring a small picture of Niblet tomorrow. 😄
Ravi Shah: Hey @Talia Park — I put a calendar invite for 1:30pm today to go over priorities and quick tour. Welcome aboard! :wave:
DevOnboardingBot: Welcome Talia! You've been added to #new-hires, #growth, and given access to the onboarding docs. Links: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding
Miguel Santos: If you ever want a climbing partner hit me up. Also curious — hedgehog keyboard hazard? ;)
Jess Lee: Heads up — the office has a strict no-live-animal policy beyond service animals, but we do hedgehog sticker swaps and plushies. :hugging_face:
Talia Park: Good to know! I'll stick to photos and Niblet plushies for the office. Thanks for the warm welcome everyone :heart:
Karen O'Neill: Welcome again! Bring your sense of humor and maybe a board game for Friday socials :)
